correctness.rationale: The exact Reeve Ehrhart polynomial L_m(k)=[mk^3+6k^2+(12-m)k+6]/6 and product identity L_{m,n}=L_mL_n imply h*=(1,9,t+u+9,9t+u+1,9t,t,0), t=(m-1)(n-1), u=10(m+n-2). The coefficient differences show universal unimodality. Of four adjacent log-concavity minors only 72-t-u can fail (the other three are nonnegative by u^2>=400t and t integer cases), giving threshold t+u<=72. For real-rootedness, t=0 reduces to discriminant 60-4u; t>0 is excluded by Newton sum-of-four positive roots unless a=b=1, where the reciprocal quartic is strictly positive. Independent exact arithmetic across 196 parameter pairs checks all formulas, not infinite proof.
